steps.name: t-1-ledger-core
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && bash -n bin/delegate && python3 -m py_compile lib/*.py && [ -f tests/test_ledger.sh ] && for f in tests/test_*.sh; do l=/tmp/gate-$(basename "$f" .sh).log; env -u DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR bash "$f" >"$l" 2>&1 || { echo "GATE FAIL $f"; grep -h FAIL "$l" | head -20; exit 1; }; done && ! git diff --name-only bench | grep -qvE '^docs/specs/(t-brief|t-design|t-chain\.json|t-1-ledger-core\.md)$|^bin/delegate$|^lib/ledger\.py$|^config\.example\.env$|^docs/reference\.md$|^tests/test_ledger\.sh$' && echo GATE-OK
